metadata.title: KMA ASOS observed heat indicators, nationwide station-year
metadata.tropical_night_definition: minimum hourly temperature from 19:00 through next day 09:00 KST >= 25C; approximates requested 18:01-09:00 window
metadata.wsdi_definition: days in runs >=6 where daily maximum exceeds calendar-day 90th percentile (5-day window)
metadata.wsdi_reference_period: 2021-2025 internal project baseline; not the standard 1991-2020 climatology
